name: Ever Harvest International Group Inc.
summary: Ever Harvest International Group Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of STEAM education products and services to the primary and secondary school markets in Hong Kong. The company was formerly known as Totally Green, Inc. and changed its name to Ever Harvest International Group Inc. in October 2021. Ever Harvest International Group Inc. was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
